scope: Trusted standalone or host-mounted UI. No review IDs or registration required.

capabilities.name: createUIRuntime
capabilities.limits: In-memory store. Caller owns stateKey identity; no reload persistence.

capabilities.name: mount
constraints: Unique live root; unmount before remount.
Same stateKey repaints all matching views; use different keys for isolation.
readOnly skips bind and ignores dispatch.
Unmount aborts delegated listeners and invokes cleanup; later dispatch is ignored.
Trusted callers only; not a security boundary.
bind runs once before the initial render. Use delegated on listeners for descendants created or replaced by render; return an optional cleanup function.

capabilities.name: on

parameters.type: Nonempty event-type string, e.g. click. Do not pass root: the helper is already scoped to the mounted root.
parameters.selector: Nonempty valid CSS selector matched with event.target.closest(selector), bounded to root.
parameters.handler: Function called as handler(event, matchedElement, dispatch).

capabilities.result: undefined; listener lifetime is owned by mount and aborted by unmount.
capabilities.example: bind({on}) { on('input', 'input[name=title]', (event, input, dispatch) => dispatch({type:'edit', title:input.value})); }
capabilities.limits: Delegates bubbling events. Use native root.addEventListener(type,handler,{signal}) for root-level or nondelegated listeners. Invalid argument types and selectors throw at binding time. Generic selector routing does not distinguish state/cache attributes from action hooks. Prefer onAction for native button commands; retain on for input/change and other explicit event semantics.

capabilities.name: onAction

parameters.actionName: Nonempty string matched exactly against data-action on the nearest native button. Not a CSS selector.
parameters.handler: handler(event, button, dispatch); read payload attributes from this button, not an ancestor.

capabilities.behavior: Delegates click (including native Enter/Space activation) within mount root. Only the nearest button can activate; non-button ancestors and unmarked buttons never act. Disabled or aria-disabled=true buttons do not dispatch. Listeners survive descendant replacement and are removed at unmount.
capabilities.example: bind({onAction}) { onAction('select-ticket', (event, button, dispatch) => dispatch({type:'select', id:button.dataset.ticket})); }
capabilities.limits: Button commands only, not links, submit handling, summaries or custom role=button widgets. Use type=button unless intentionally submitting. data-action is reserved for command identity, never view state/cache. Existing on callers are not automatically migrated.

capabilities.name: dispatch
capabilities.availableIn: bind context, delegated handler third argument, and mount result
capabilities.behavior: Synchronously reduces the current state and renders all views sharing stateKey. Dispatch is ignored after unmount or in readOnly mode.
capabilities.limits: A render may replace descendant DOM. Re-query any destination after dispatch before focusing it.

capabilities.name: focusWorkflowStep
capabilities.prerequisites: Connected visible destination heading in ordered [data-step]/[data-stage] panels, or explicit selector.
capabilities.timing: After committed Next/Back render only; never initial mount, typing or every render.
capabilities.result: Sets tabindex=-1, focuses destination heading, returns actual focus success; false for absent/disconnected/hidden target.
capabilities.limits: Not automatic; caller supplies actual destination index and verifies activation. Asynchronous renders must complete first.

capabilities.name: findUIElementById
capabilities.behavior: Exact string ID lookup among root descendants; returns Element or null. Does not interpret selector syntax and cannot select outside root. Works on detached roots. Invalid arguments throw.
capabilities.limits: IDs must be unique within the component; root itself is excluded. Linear lookup. This does not escape HTML interpolation or generate unique IDs. Caller owns focus timing and replacement semantics.
capabilities.verification: scripts/check-render-restoration.mjs covers punctuation, root isolation, removed targets and replacement.
